data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to detect soft keyboard visibility on Android, iOS, web, and desktop.
data.what_it_does: Provides a stream of keyboard visibility changes and widgets to react to them. It also offers a widget to dismiss the keyboard on tap and a controller for direct queries.
use_when: Reacting to keyboard visibility changes in the UI
Dismissing the keyboard when the user taps outside a text field
Testing keyboard visibility logic in widget tests
avoid_when: Using it on web where it always reports false
Relying on it for complex state management beyond keyboard visibility
strengths: Simple API with builder, provider, and controller
Built‑in widget to dismiss keyboard on tap
weaknesses: Requires native platform setup for full functionality
